title: PFAS (Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances) in Food & Cosmetics: Regulatory Intelligence
excerpt: Comprehensive regulatory tracker for PFAS in food contact materials, food packaging, and cosmetics. Covers the FDA voluntary phase-out, 15+ state bans, MoCRA cosmetics report, EU REACH restriction proposal, and EPA drinking water limits.
seo_title: PFAS Regulation Tracker: FDA Food Packaging & Cosmetics | Policy Canary
seo_description: Track PFAS regulations affecting food companies: FDA voluntary phase-out complete, 15+ state bans on food packaging, cosmetics PFAS bans in 5+ states, EU REACH restriction, and EPA drinking water limits. Updated March 2026.
